metadata.purpose: Separates G2 from FG2. G2 does NOT imply FG2.
metadata.theorem: G2 does not imply FG2 (3-element witness)
metadata.long_description: G2=T FG2=F FP=F. G2 without FG2, no syntactic FP. G2 holds vacuously: boxtimes(T)=c and c is not <=bot in the discrete preorder, so the G2 antecedent is false. The orbit T->c->T->c oscillates; FG2 fails because boxtimes^2(T)=T and T is not <=c=boxtimes(T) in the discrete order.
